title: TV: sign in on your phone
note: First run or Account › Sign in: three steps, the six-letter code (RFC 8628's alphabet), the QR with the same link, a waiting card that moves on by itself; the typed fallback is a secondary button

title: TV: this TV already has things
note: Asked once when a device that was used without an account signs in: what is on the TV against what is in the account, Merge them (recommended, focused) or Use my account's only, with the 30-day snapshot named

title: TV: Account › airglow account
note: A new first group: who is signed in, Synced · Sync now, Devices (this TV named), What syncs (and what stays on the TV), Sign out of this TV, Sign out everywhere

title: iPhone: sign in this TV?
note: Opened by Open in airglow (an airglow:// link) over whatever was on screen: the TV's name and code, the question Is this the code on your TV?, the same-Wi-Fi tick when the addresses match, what it gets (no other sign-in), Sign in the TV · Not now, where the lock lives

title: iPhone: sign in
note: First run: email and password, the recovery-key link, then the two other doors: create an account with an invite, or use airglow without an account (the provider sign-in as today)

title: iPhone: your recovery key
note: Sign-up step 2 of 3: the 20-character key in five groups, Copy · Save to Files, the tick that it is kept, Continue; where to see it again later

title: A phone browser: the Worker's page
note: What the QR opens: Open in airglow leads (the app signs the TV in with one tap); below it, for a phone without the app, the code, email and password; the key is unwrapped in the browser and re-locked for the TV

title: Windows: Account › airglow account
note: Two panes: Devices (name, how and when it signed in, Active now / Last seen, Sign out each, This PC; nothing about what plays), Security (password, recovery key, what the server has), Sync (what syncs, what stays local, Undo), Friends (an invite code), Sign out, Delete account
